name: Ebonite Game Breaker 3 X-OUT Bowling Ball
description: Ebonite continues the successful Game Breaker line of mid performance bowling balls with the Game Breaker 3. Ebonite has taken the proven motion of the original Game Breaker 2 and amped up the coverstock to give tournament bowlers the ideal ball for current oil conditions. The Enhanced V2 core paired with the GB 12.7 Hybrid coverstock is compatible with any medium to heavy oiled lanes for a variety of bowling styles. This bowling ball offers predictable and continuous ball motion like no other. - Color: Black/Purple - Coverstock: GB 12.7 Hybrid - Core: Enhanced V2 - Finish: 500 / 2000 Abralon - Reaction: Strong Mid-lane and Continuous Hook - Recommended Lane Condition: Medium to Heavy Oil - RG: 2.48 (15# ball) - Differential: .048 (15# ball)
